welcome:
Welcome to Links to EPUB!

Send me any article URL and I'll convert it to an EPUB file.

Commands:
/help - Usage instructions
/settings - Open settings
/history - Recent conversions
/status - Subscription status
/subscribe - Upgrade to premium
help:
How to use this bot:

1. Send me a link to any article or web page
2. I'll convert it to EPUB format
3. You'll receive the file right here in the chat

Supported: any public web page with article content.

Privacy: Your files are deleted immediately after sending. We only store metadata (URL, title, timestamps) for your conversion history.

Disclaimer: This bot is provided as-is. Content conversion depends on the source page structure and may not always produce perfect results.
